{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in revenue
print("Revenue sentinel values:")
print(df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99'])

# Check for refunded orders
print("Refunded orders:")
print(df[df['status'] == 'refunded'])

# Check for any invalid revenue values
print("Invalid revenue values:")
invalid_revenue = df[~df['revenue'].str.match(r'^\d+,?\d*\.\d{2}$')]
print(invalid_revenue['revenue'].unique())"}
